1.en: By those sent in succession ‘urfan that is by the winds that follow one another in succession like the mane ‘urf of a horse one part of hair coming after the other ‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier;
1.ar:
سُورَة المُرْسَلات [ مَكِّيَّة وآياتها خَمْسُونَ ]

﴿والمُرْسَلات عُرْفًا﴾ أيْ الرِّياح مُتَتابِعَة كَعُرْفِ الفَرَس يَتْلُو بَعْضه بَعْضًا ونَصْبه عَلى الحال

2.en: by the raging hurricanes the violent winds;

3.en: by the sweeping spreaders by the winds that scatter the rains;

4.en: by the decisive discriminators that is by the verses of the Qur’ān which discriminate between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;
4.ar: ﴿فالفارِقات فَرْقًا﴾ أيْ آيات القُرْآن تَفْرُق بَيْن الحَقّ والباطِل والحَلال والحَرام

5.en: by the casters of the remembrance that is by angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers casting the revelation onto the various communities of mankind
5.ar: ﴿فالمُلْقِيات ذِكْرًا﴾ أيْ المَلائِكَة تَنْزِل بِالوَحْيِ إلى الأَنْبِياء والرُّسُل يُلْقُونَ الوَحْي إلى الأُمَم

6.en: to excuse or to warn that is to say in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God exalted be He a variant reading for nudhran and ‘udhran has nudhuran and ‘udhuran.
6.ar: ﴿عُذْرًا أوْ نُذْرًا﴾ أيْ لِلْإعْذارِ والإنْذار مِن اللَّه تَعالى وفِي قِراءَة بِضَمِّ ذال نُذْرًا وقُرِئَ بِضَمِّ ذال عُذْرًا

7.en: Surely that which you are promised O disbelievers of Mecca in the way of resurrection and chastisement will befall it will be without any doubt.
7.ar: ﴿إنّما تُوعَدُونَ﴾ أيْ يا كُفّار مَكَّة مِن البَعْث والعَذاب ﴿لَواقِع﴾ كائِن لا مَحالَة

8.en: So when the stars are obliterated when their light is extinguished

9.en: and when the heaven is rent asunder

10.en: and when the mountains are blown away crushed to pieces and blown in the air

11.en: and when the time is set for the testimony of the messengers read uqqitat or wuqqitat that is to say when they are gathered to an appointed time
11.ar: ﴿وإذا الرُّسُل أُقِّتَتْ﴾ أُقِّتَتْ بِالواوِ وبِالهَمْزَةِ بَدَلًا مِنها أيْ جُمِعَتْ لِوَقْتٍ

12.en: For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed? it has been appointed for witnessing of the messengers against their communities to the effect that they delivered their messages from God.
12.ar: ﴿لِأَيّ يَوْم﴾ لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيم ﴿أُجِّلَتْ﴾ لِلشَّهادَةِ عَلى أُمَمهمْ بِالتَّبْلِيغِ

13.en: For the Day of Decision for creatures from this one may infer the response to the clauses beginning with idhā ‘when’ in other words ‘when … the decision will be made for all creatures’.
13.ar: ﴿لِيَوْمِ الفَصْل﴾ بَيْن الخَلْق ويُؤْخَذ مِنهُ جَواب إذا أيْ وقَعَ الفَصْل بَيْن الخَلائِق

14.en: And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.
14.ar: ﴿وما أدْراك ما يَوْم الفَصْل﴾ تَهْوِيل لِشَأْنِهِ

15.en: Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.

16.en: Did We not destroy the ancients for their denial in other words We certainly destroyed them

17.en: then made the latter folk follow them? the latter folk of those who denied such as the disbelievers of Mecca whom We will destroy.
17.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ نُتْبِعهُمْ الآخِرِينَ﴾ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبُوا كَكُفّارِ مَكَّة فَنُهْلِكهُمْ

18.en: So just as We dealt with those who denied will We deal with the guilty with every individual who will be guilty in the future and destroy them.
18.ar: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ مِثْل ما فَعَلْنا بِالمُكَذِّبِينَ ﴿نَفْعَل بِالمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ بِكُلِّ مَن أجْرَمَ فِيما يَسْتَقْبِل فَنُهْلِكهُمْ

19.en: Woe to the deniers on that day! — reiterated for emphasis.

20.en: Did We not create you from a base fluid one that is delicate — and this is semen
20.ar: ﴿ألَمْ نَخْلُقكُمْ مِن ماء مَهِين﴾ ضَعِيف وهُوَ المَنِيّ

21.en: then lodged it in a secure abode that is the womb
21.ar: ﴿فَجَعَلْناهُ فِي قَرار مَكِين﴾ حَرِيز وهُوَ الرَّحِم

22.en: for a known span? namely the time for delivery.

23.en: Thus We were able to do this; so how excellent able ones We are!

24.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

25.en: Have We not made the earth a receptacle kifātan is a verbal noun from kafata meaning damma ‘enclosed’ that is an enclosure
25.ar: ﴿كِفاتًا﴾ مَصْدَر كَفَتَ بِمَعْنى ضَمَّ أيْ ضامَّة

26.en: for the living on its surface and the dead inside it

27.en: and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?
27.ar: ﴿وجَعَلْنا فِيها رَواسِي شامِخات﴾ جِبالًا مُرْتَفِعات ﴿وأَسْقَيْناكُمْ ماء فُراتًا﴾ عَذْبًا

28.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!
28.ar: ﴿ويَلِ يَوْمئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ ويُقال لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ يَوْم القِيامَة

29.en: And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers Depart to that chastisement which you used to deny!
29.ar: ﴿انْطَلِقُوا إلى ما كُنْتُمْ بِهِ﴾ مِن العَذاب

30.en: Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell which as it rises splits into three parts because of its magnitude —
30.ar: ﴿انْطَلِقُوا إلى ظِلّ ذِي ثَلاث شُعَب﴾ هُوَ دُخان جَهَنَّم إذا ارْتَفَعَ افْتَرَقَ ثَلاث فِرَق لِعِظَمِهِ

31.en: which is neither shady neither protective unable to shade them from the heat of that Day nor of any avail against nor wards off from them anything of the flame the Fire.
31.ar: ﴿لا ظَلِيل﴾ كَنِين يُظِلّهُمْ مِن حَرّ ذَلِكَ اليَوْم ﴿ولا يُغْنِي﴾ يَرُدّ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا ﴿مِن اللَّهَب﴾ النّار

32.en: Indeed it that is the Fire throws up sparks namely those flame that are thrown by it into the air huge like palace edifices in terms of their enormity and vertical extension
32.ar: ﴿إنّها﴾ أيْ النّار ﴿تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ﴾ هُوَ ما تَطايَرَ مِنها ﴿كالقَصْرِ﴾ مِن البِناء فِي عِظَمه وارْتِفاعه

33.en: as if they were dark yellow camels jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth it is stated ‘The sparks of humans thrown into the air by the Fire are black as pitch qīr’; the Arabs call dark camels sufr ‘yellow’ because a touch of yellow is mixed with their blackish colour and therefore it is said that ‘yellow’ in this verse actually means ‘black’ on account of what has been mentioned; but some say no to this interpretation; sharar is the plural of sharāra; qīr is qār ‘pitch’.
33.ar: ﴿كَأَنَّهُ جِمالات﴾ جِمالات جَمْع جَمَل وفِي قِراءَة جِمالَت ﴿صُفْر﴾ فِي هَيْئَتها ولَوْنها وفِي الحَدِيث "شِرار النّاس أسْوَد كالقِيرِ" والعَرَب تُسَمِّي سُود الإبِل صُفْرًا لِشَوْبِ سَوادها بِصُفْرَةٍ فَقِيلَ صُفْر فِي الآيَة بِمَعْنى سُود لِما ذُكِرَ وقِيلَ لا والشَّرَر: جَمْع شَرارَة والقِير: القار

34.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

35.en: This namely the Day of Resurrection is the day in which they will not utter anything
35.ar: ﴿هَذا﴾ أيْ يَوْم القِيامَة ﴿يَوْم لا يَنْطِقُونَ﴾ فِيهِ بِشَيْءٍ

36.en: nor will they be given permission to offer excuses and so offer excuses fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu ‘given permission’ but without being a direct result of it since it belongs within the confines of the general denial of permission in other words ‘there will be no permission hence no excuses’.
36.ar: ﴿ولا يُؤْذَن لَهُمْ﴾ فِي العُذْر ﴿فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ﴾ عَطْف عَلى يُؤْذَن مِن غَيْر تَسَبُّب عَنْهُ فَهُوَ داخِل فِي حَيِّز النَّفْي أيْ لا إذْن فَلا اعْتِذار

37.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

38.en: ‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you O deniers from this community and the ancients together the ancients from among the deniers before you so that you will all be reckoned with and chastised together;
38.ar: ﴿هَذا يَوْم الفَصْل جَمَعْناكُمْ﴾ أيّها المُكَذِّبُونَ مِن هَذِهِ الأُمَّة ﴿والأَوَّلِينَ﴾ مِن المُكَذِّبِينَ قَبْلكُمْ فَتُحاسَبُونَ وتُعَذَّبُونَ جَمِيعًا

39.en: So if you have any stratagems any ploy to ward off your chastisement try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!
39.ar: ﴿فَإنْ كانَ لَكُمْ كَيْد﴾ حِيلَة فِي دَفْع العَذاب عَنْكُمْ ﴿فَكِيدُونِ﴾ فافْعَلُوها

40.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

41.en: Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades that is amid clusters of trees since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade and springs issuing forth with water
41.ar: ﴿إنّ المُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلال﴾ أيْ تَكاثُف أشْجار إذْ لا شَمْس يُظِلّ مِن حَرّها ﴿وعُيُون﴾ نابِعَة مِن الماء

42.en: and fruits such as they desire this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is done according to their desires in contrast to the case in this world where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them
42.ar: ﴿وفَواكِه مِمّا يَشْتَهُونَ﴾ فِيهِ إعْلام بِأَنَّ المَأْكَل والمَشْرَب فِي الجَنَّة بِحَسَبِ شَهَواتهمْ بِخِلافِ الدُّنْيا فَبِحَسَبِ ما يَجِد النّاس فِي الأَغْلَب ويُقال لَهُمْ:

43.en: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mutahanni’īna for what you used to do’ in the way of obedience.
43.ar: ﴿كُلُوا واشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا﴾ حال أيْ مُتَهَنِّئِينَ ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ مِن الطّاعَة

44.en: Indeed so in the same way that We reward the God-fearing do We reward the virtuous.

45.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

46.en: ‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little time at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’
46.ar: ﴿كُلُوا وتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ خِطاب لِلْكُفّارِ فِي الدُّنْيا ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ مِن الزَّمان وغايَته إلى المَوْت وفِي هَذا تَهْدِيد لَهُمْ

47.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

48.en: For when it is said to them ‘Bow down!’ perform prayer they do not bow down they do not perform prayer.
48.ar: ﴿وإذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ارْكَعُوا﴾ صَلُّوا ﴿لا يَرْكَعُونَ﴾ لا يُصَلُّونَ

49.en: Woe to the deniers on that day!

50.en: In what discourse then after this namely the Qur’ān will they believe? In other words they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this Qur’ān since it comprises that inimitability i‘jāz which none of the others do.
50.ar: ﴿فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيث بَعْده﴾ أيْ القُرْآن ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ أيْ لا يَمْكَن إيمانهمْ بِغَيْرِهِ مِن كُتُب اللَّه بَعْد تَكْذِيبهمْ بِهِ لِاشْتِمالِهِ عَلى الإعْجاز الَّذِي لَمْ يَشْتَمِل عَلَيْهِ غَيْره.
